p: Jurgens will keep his current position on the offensive line despite the Ryan Neuzil addition.
His job looks secure and the line's alignment should stay stable as a new QB arrives.
I don't anticipate anything changing with cam and what position he plays.
Jurgens is cleared from protocol and is expected to make his first start for Baltimore on Sunday.
A veteran center stabilizing the interior line could help the run game and pass protection for Baltimore's skill players.
I expect him to actually really lift that area for us.
